<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe " <!ENTITY ent 'parameter entity value'> ">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY base "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY extended "&base; and &ent;">
  <?target-pi data="processing instruction content"?>
  <!-- Root level comment before doctype closure -->
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub" xmlns:other="http://example.com/ns/other">
  <!-- Comment inside root element -->
  <?sub:pi action="test"?>
  <sub:child sub:attr="value">
    &extended;
    <![CDATA[
      Some CDATA content with markup-like characters: <tag> & "quotes"
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST item id ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ENTITY % local_ext "<!ENTITY sec 'Secondary Entity'>">
  %local_ext;
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
  <!-- DTD internal subset comment -->
]>
<catalog xmlns="urn:catalog" xmlns:item-ns="urn:catalog:item" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Header comment for items -->
  <?catalog-pi target="validate" status="ok"?>
  <item-ns:item id="i1" xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block containing <<nested>> brackets & entities &sec;
    ]]>
  </item-ns:item>
  <item-ns:item id="i2">
    &sec;
  </item-ns:item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (paragraph*)>
  <!ELEMENT paragraph (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; -> Second Entity">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?doc-info author="Tester" version="1.0"?>
  <!-- Document type definition main comment -->
]>
<document xmlns="http://w3.org/document" xmlns:sec="http://w3.org/document/section" xmlns:attr="http://w3.org/document/attr">
  <!-- Section container comment -->
  <sec:section attr:id="sec1">
    <?sec:action run="parse"?>
    <sec:paragraph>
      <![CDATA[
        CDATA block spanning multiple lines
        with explicit CDATA termination check: ]]]]><![CDATA[>
        and entity reference: &ent2;
      ]]>
    </sec:paragraph>
  </sec:section>
</document>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE config [
  <!ELEMENT config (setting*)>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % dtd-param "<!ENTITY param-ent 'Parameter Value'>">
  %dtd-param;
  <!ENTITY normal-ent "Normal Value &param-ent;">
  <?config-engine mode="debug" verbose="true"?>
  <!-- Configuration DTD block comment -->
]>
<config xmlns="http://config.org/ns" xmlns:cfg="http://config.org/ns/cfg" xmlns:ext="http://config.org/ns/ext">
  <!-- Settings block comment -->
  <?cfg:control state="active"?>
  <cfg:setting ext:name="timeout">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA containing configuration snippets: <setting id="1">val</setting>
    ]]>
    &normal-ent;
  </cfg:setting>
</config>
```

<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST item code CDATA #REQUIRED>
  <!ENTITY % ext-subset "
    <!ENTITY deep-ent 'Deeply nested entity string'>
  ">
  %ext-subset;
  <?inventory-log date="2023-10-01" level="info"?>
  <!-- Inventory DTD root comment -->
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org" xmlns:inv="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://inventory.org/ns/meta">
  <!-- Inventory items list comment -->
  <?meta:processor name="fast-parser"?>
  <inv:item inv:code="A-100">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with raw XML: <inv:item>Not parsed</inv:item>
    ]]>
    &deep-ent;
  </inv:item>
</inventory>
